verdict.rationale: Figma documents a built-in agent that takes natural-language direction to generate design directions, create diagrams, edit images and search files. It also documents MCP-driven canvas writes and FigJam diagrams generated from prompts, so the product itself supports natural-language operation for a meaningful subset of tasks. The docs do not show natural language covering the product broadly, and one community user calls the FigJam AI tools "really bad and often broken", which lowers confidence without contradicting the documented capability. Missing for 10: evidence that natural-language commands extend beyond generation, editing and search to prototyping, publishing, admin and other workflows; independent hands-on corroboration of reliability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Use the Figma agent to generate new design directions, create diagrams, edit images, search your files, and more.
